job.question: In the Baltimore City Employees' Retirement Systems (BCERS) RFP for an alternatives consultant, how many years must the proposing firm have been in business?
job.expected_facts: At least seven (7) years providing general consulting services plus private equity consulting services, or alternatives consulting services only (all minimum qualifications must be met as of November 8, 2024, 3:00 p.m. EDT).
job.acceptance: Seven years is sufficient for the narrow question. Service type and qualification deadline are optional; five-year staff experience is not the firm threshold.

reviews.reason: This is Clark County, Washington’s 2026 RFP for a deferred compensation plan administrator, not BCERS’s RFP for an alternatives consultant. Its five-year minimum concerns experience administering governmental Section 457 plans; its seven-year reference concerns an optional contract extension, not the proposing firm’s years in business.
quotes: Request for Proposal #955 Deferred Compensation 457 Plan Administrator

Clark County is soliciting proposals from qualified firms to provide retirement plan administration, record keeping, education, communications, investment-related, and other services for the 457 Deferred Compensation Plan effective January 1, 2027.
The Proposing Firm must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience administering governmental Section 457 deferred compensation plans
Clark County reserves the right to extend the contract resulting from this RFP for a period of seven (7) additional years
